TGNet user-provided checkpoint policy

source: user-provided
license: not-verified
bundled_by_app: false

TGNet checkpoint files are not bundled or automatically downloaded. They are
not provided and not redistributed by TotalSegmentator Wrapper for Mac. A user who enables the
TGNet-compatible path must obtain the specified files independently from the
distribution page linked by the application and review the distributor's
terms before use.

The packaged application recognizes this compatibility set only after strict
filename and SHA-256 validation:

- tgnet_fps.h5
  SHA-256: 024f585f20924c08eafced8fdc633015b0cc8bba04301d585b4cf7a0c02206b6
- tgnet_bdl.h5
  SHA-256: 5ec7780d7d645af522c6f2888093e5ca8e11c631d0e13798d208ba2a157554d1

Acceptance by the compatibility validator does not verify or grant a license
for either checkpoint. The independently implemented application code and the
user-provided checkpoint files have separate provenance and licensing scopes.
